name: dealer-vdp-merchandising-review
description: Review a sample of Vehicle Detail Pages (VDPs) on a car dealership website for merchandising quality. 10 dimensions covering photos, descriptions, pricing, vehicle data, schema, CTAs, trust signals, cross-sell, mobile UX, and OEM compliance. Brand-aware: applies OEM-specific standards for GM, Ford, Stellantis, Toyota, Honda, Hyundai/Kia, VW/Audi, Subaru, and falls back to brand-neutral checks for other brands. Outputs per-VDP scorecards plus a summary headline and prioritized fix list.
